Document.save.note: Supports garbage= as a bool, deflate=, object_streams=, user_pw=, owner_pw=, and permissions= with AES-256; M7 adds the remaining options and F6 the garbage levels.

Document.select.note: Repeated page numbers insert independent copies; pymupdf repeats references to the same page object.

Document.set_metadata.note: Rejects the format, encryption, and trapped keys, so doc.metadata cannot be passed back unchanged; an empty dictionary changes nothing.

Document.set_toc.note: Takes [level, title, page] entries; M5 adds collapse= and fourth-element dictionaries.

Document.stream.note: pylopdf does not expose the bytes it opened; tobytes() serializes the current document.

Document.this.note: Handle of pymupdf's MuPDF binding; it has no PDF-level meaning.

Document.this_is_pdf.note: pymupdf's internal bookkeeping; it has no PDF-level meaning.

Document.thisown.note: Handle of pymupdf's MuPDF binding; it has no PDF-level meaning.

Page.bound.note: Page.rect returns the same rectangle; M2 adds bound().

Page.cropbox.note: Returns the /CropBox in PDF coordinates with a bottom-left origin; pymupdf reports it with a top-left origin.

Page.draw_cont.note: pymupdf's internal bookkeeping; it has no PDF-level meaning.

Page.get_drawings.note: Returns typed path dictionaries without extended=; M1 adds the clip and group hierarchy.

Page.insert_image.note: Supports filename=, stream=, pixmap=, rotate=, keep_proportion=, and overlay=; M2 adds mask=, alpha=, xref=, width=, height=, and oc=.

Page.insert_link.note: add_link_annot(rect, uri) creates URI links; M3 adds insert_link() for every link kind.

Page.insert_text.note: Supports fontsize=, fontname= (short Standard 14 aliases), fontfile=, color=, and overlay=, plus fontbuffer=, fontindex=, and font_language=; M2 adds lineheight=, rotate=, morph=, render_mode=, fill=, border_width=, miter_limit=, the opacities, and oc=. Page.insert_textbox.note: Supports fontsize=, fontname=, fontfile=, color=, align=, expandtabs=, lineheight=, and overlay=, plus fontbuffer=, fontindex=, and font_language=; M2 adds rotate=, morph=, render_mode=, fill=, border_width=, miter_limit=, the opacities, and oc=. Pixmap.save.note: Writes PNG only, to a .png path named path rather than filename; M1 adds output= and jpg_quality= for JPEG and PNM/PAM.

Pixmap.this.note: Handle of pymupdf's MuPDF binding; it has no PDF-level meaning.

Pixmap.tobytes.note: Returns PNG bytes bounded by max_size=; M1 adds output= and jpg_quality=.

Pixmap.warp.note: Perspective warping of a raster is a MuPDF internal without PDF-level meaning.

TextPage.note: pylopdf caches each page's interpretation internally, so get_text, search_for, and to_markdown need no TextPage object; pylopdf.TextPage names the dict output.

TextPage.parent.note: No TextPage objects; pylopdf caches each page's interpretation internally.

TextPage.poolsize.note: Size of MuPDF's text memory pool; it has no PDF-level meaning.

TextPage.rect.note: No TextPage objects; Page.rect is the extraction rectangle.

Point.note: Immutable NamedTuple of x and y; F4 adds pymupdf's methods and operators.

Point.__add__.note: On the NamedTuple, + concatenates tuples; F4 adds pymupdf's coordinate arithmetic.

Point.__bool__.note: A NamedTuple is always true; pymupdf treats an all-zero value as false.

Point.__getitem__.note: Indexing returns the coordinates, as in pymupdf.

Point.__mul__.note: On the NamedTuple, * repeats the tuple; F4 adds transformation by a matrix.

Point.__setitem__.note: Coordinates are read-only because the NamedTuple is immutable.

Point.x.note: Read-only field of the immutable NamedTuple.

Point.y.note: Read-only field of the immutable NamedTuple.

Rect.note: Immutable NamedTuple of x0, y0, x1, and y1 with width and height; F4 adds pymupdf's methods and operators.

Rect.__add__.note: On the NamedTuple, + concatenates tuples; F4 adds pymupdf's coordinate arithmetic.

Rect.__bool__.note: A NamedTuple is always true; pymupdf treats an all-zero value as false.

Rect.__contains__.note: On the NamedTuple, in tests coordinate values; F4 adds geometric containment.

Rect.__getitem__.note: Indexing returns the coordinates, as in pymupdf.

Rect.__mul__.note: On the NamedTuple, * repeats the tuple; F4 adds transformation by a matrix.

Rect.__setitem__.note: Coordinates are read-only because the NamedTuple is immutable.

Rect.height.note: Can be negative for an inverted rectangle, where pymupdf returns 0.

Rect.width.note: Can be negative for an inverted rectangle, where pymupdf returns 0.

Rect.x0.note: Read-only field of the immutable NamedTuple.

Rect.x1.note: Read-only field of the immutable NamedTuple.

Rect.y0.note: Read-only field of the immutable NamedTuple.

Rect.y1.note: Read-only field of the immutable NamedTuple.
